remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Mrs. Liebman's apartment, Jan. 1946. . . . No signature on front [notes backing inscription]. . . . Miss O'Keeffe calls this 'Pink Daisy and Orchid.' Mrs. Liebman calls it 'Pink African Daisy and Orchid.' Owned by Mrs. Charles Liebman." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Bought from O'Keeffe by Mrs. Liebman and given to her sister Mrs. Blumenthal. When Mrs. Blumenthal died, it was returned to Mrs. Liebman." (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Pink Daisy with Iris

description: A blue iris with white and yellow outer petals blooms in the bottom right of the composition. A pink daisy with a pale yellow center sits in the top left of the work. The delicate flowers, with their pastel-colored petals, almost face into a pale blue, white, and gray background.
title: Pink Daisy with Iris
